consumption_rule: Reservation/directory creation or partial worker start spends the new allowance, including incomplete outcomes; no retry or alternate directory

diagnostic.acceptance: Evidence is not an accuracy/rank/resource PASS; unchanged scientific gates
diagnostic.content: latest exact lifted/scaled CSR/RHS, state, scales, fixed indices/values, correction, clean source binding and SuperLU settings
diagnostic.partial_write: retain prior complete record and .writing file; refuse before solve

pre_reservation_recovery: Only demonstrated caller/preflight error before reservation, worker or numerical import: preserve failure and timing gaps, verify absent directory and no new manager process, fix/test, republish clean source binding, continue same unspent allocation. Uncertain state stops for review.
procedure: run_once.py; supervised SystemdBackend and supervise_once; no standalone numerical import or prewarming
scope: One NEW later n=2 Poiseuille fixture using reviewed serial SuperLU and bounded latest CSR evidence; execution requires later Continue

solver.controls: R240 fixed options; no fallback or regularization

source_commit_rule: Actual clean launch HEAD; all R241 source_sha256 values and exact artifact bindings must match; old allocations unchanged
state_before_launch: ADMITTED_FOR_LATER_EXECUTION; no R241 reservation or worker in this review
